content.title: 2024 Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery Guideline

topics.description: Studies on mitral valve procedures and outcomes in various patient groups, including pregnant women, and effects on fetal and maternal outcomes.
Recommendations on management and future directions, including monitoring with echocardiography.

sections.heading: Transcatheter or Mitral Valve Implantation or Edge-to-Edge Repair

topics.description: Studies on outcomes and complications after transcatheter and surgical interventions, including outcomes in severe aortic stenosis and atrial fibrillation assessment.
Considerations for anticoagulation in patients with atrial fibrillation undergoing noncardiac surgery.
